In 298 BC, there Was 1 serious famine in Magadha (South Bihar)

They returned backafter 12years The leaderof the group, which = stayed
back at Magadha was Sthulabladral When the Jains (Bhadrabahu and
others) returned from South India, they held thatcomplete nudity be an
essentialpartofthe teachingsof Mahavira, whilethe monksin Magadha
began to put on white clothes.
Thus arose the two sects Shretambans (white clad) and Digambaras
(sky-clad):
Shvetambars(i.e those who put on white robes) Sthulabhadra
Digambaras (i.e. those who were stark naked) _ Bhadrabahu
